# Cold War Project: flag lists of the countries on the map at 1946.1.1.
# GENERATED by tools/flags/gen_flags.py from tools/flags/cwp_flags_table.txt and the vanilla lists.
# Do not edit by hand: change the table (or the script) and rerun. See docs/agents/areas/flags.md.
# The file name sorts after zz_vanilla_flag_definitions.txt on purpose: it REPLACEs lists that file also replaces (JAP).
# Each list is the CWP definitions followed by the vanilla definitions that can still occur after 1946 ("# vanilla").
# Priorities (the valid definition with the highest priority wins; DEFAULT is always included):
#   900        start flag, no trigger
#   901-989    vanilla variants (republic, monarchy, dictatorship, theocracy, subject ensigns ...): 900 + vanilla priority
#   990        flag after leaving subject status (occupied Germany, dominions, colonies)
#   1000       DEFAULT: random communist flag (2000: anarchy)
#   1100       the tag's own communist flag
#   1500       vanilla communist/fascist flags (kept as vanilla set them); start flag of countries that begin
#              communist, while they stay communist
#   1600       communist successor flag after leaving subject status (DDR, North Korea)
#   1700       CWP national regime variants (people's republic, Islamic republic, military rule ...)
# Art: common/coat_of_arms/coat_of_arms/cwp_*.txt (cwp_ keys), otherwise vanilla keys.

# Scripted values used by the vanilla definitions copied below (from 00_flag_definitions.txt).
@coa_width = 768
@coa_height = 512
@canton_scale_cross_x = @[ ( 333 / coa_width ) + 0.001 ]
@canton_scale_cross_y = @[ ( 205 / coa_height ) + 0.001 ]
@canton_scale_sweden_x = @[ ( 255 / coa_width ) + 0.001 ]
@canton_scale_sweden_y = @[ ( 204 / coa_height ) + 0.001 ]

	}
	flag_definition = {	# as Ethiopia: People's Democratic Republic (1987)
		coa = cwp_ETH_pdre
		subject_canton = cwp_ETH_pdre
		priority = 1700
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_peoples_republic_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# as Ethiopia: Federal Democratic Republic (1996)
		coa = cwp_ETH_fdre
		subject_canton = cwp_ETH_fdre
		priority = 1700
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_democratic_republic_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# vanilla ETH
		coa = ETH_absolute_monarchy

	}
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:AFH = {	# Kingdom of Afghanistan
	flag_definition = {
		coa = cwp_AFH_1946
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_1946
		priority = 900
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Democratic Republic of Afghanistan (1978): people's republic not under a Soviet overlord
		coa = cwp_AFH_democratic_republic
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_democratic_republic
		priority = 1700
		trigger = {
			cwp_coa_def_peoples_republic_flag_trigger = yes
			NOT = {
				scope:overlord ?= { c:RUS ?= this }
			}
		}
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Islamic Emirate (1997)
		coa = cwp_AFH_islamic_emirate
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_islamic_emirate
		priority = 1700
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_islamic_emirate_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Republic of Afghanistan (1973, Daoud): non-communist republic under one-man, one-party or military rule
		coa = cwp_AFH_republic
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_republic
		priority = 1650
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_republican_dictatorship_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Democratic Republic of Afghanistan (1980, Karmal): communist one-party state under a Soviet overlord
		coa = cwp_AFH_1980
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_1980
		priority = 1700
		trigger = {
			coa_def_communist_flag_trigger = yes
			scope:overlord ?= { c:RUS ?= this }
			cwp_coa_def_peoples_democracy_flag_trigger = no
		}
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Republic of Afghanistan (1987, Najibullah's national reconciliation): communist-led with other parties allowed (people's democracy)
		coa = cwp_AFH_1987
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_1987
		priority = 1700
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_peoples_democracy_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Islamic State of Afghanistan (1992, mujahideen government): Islamic republic
		coa = cwp_AFH_islamic_state
		subject_canton = cwp_AFH_islamic_state
		priority = 1700
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_islamic_republic_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# vanilla AFG
		coa = AFG_republic
		subject_canton = AFG_republic
		priority = 910
		trigger = { coa_def_republic_flag_trigger = yes }

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:AOZ = {	# American zone of Germany: C pennant
	flag_definition = {
		coa = cwp_GER_occupied_1946
		subject_canton = cwp_GER_occupied_1946
		priority = 900
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Federal German flag
		coa = GER_modern
		subject_canton = GER_modern
		priority = 990
		trigger = { coa_def_independent_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# vanilla GER
		coa = GER_ddr
		subject_canton = GER_ddr
		priority = 1500
		trigger = {
			scope:actor ?= {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state
						py:communist_party ?= {
							any_member = { is_in_government = yes }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						OR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_technocracy
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_oligarchy
						}
						ruler ?= {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						is_subject = yes
						overlord = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_presidential_republic
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flag_definition = {	# vanilla GER
		coa = GER_fascist
		subject_canton = GER_fascist
		priority = 1250
		trigger = { coa_def_fascist_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# vanilla GER
		coa = GER_nihilist
		subject_canton = GER_nihilist
		priority = 1500
		trigger = { coa_def_nihilist_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# generic
		coa = list "cwp_islamic"
		priority = 901
		trigger = { cwp_coa_def_islamic_theocracy_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
}

REPLACE:BRZ = {	# Brazil
	flag_definition = {
		coa = BRZ_republic
		subject_canton = BRZ_republic
		priority = 900
	}
	flag_definition = {
		coa = BRZ_communist
		priority = 1100
		trigger = { coa_def_communist_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# vanilla
		coa = BRZ
		subject_canton = BRZ
		allow_overlord_canton = no
		priority = 905
		trigger = {
			scope:actor ?= {
				country_has_monarchy_law = yes
				OR = {
					AND = {
						exists = c:POR
						is_subject_of = c:POR
					}
					AND = {
						exists = c:IBE
						is_subject_of = c:IBE
					}
				}
				is_subject_type = subject_type_personal_union
			}
		}
	}
	flag_definition = {	# vanilla
		coa = BRZ_oligarchic_republic
		subject_canton = BRZ_oligarchic_republic
		priority = 920
		trigger = {
			scope:actor ?= {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_presidential_republic
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_landed_voting
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_tenant_farmers
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flag_definition = {	# vanilla
		coa = BRZ_fascist
		subject_canton = BRZ_fascist
		priority = 1500
		trigger = { coa_def_fascist_flag_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# vanilla
		coa = BRZ_subject_GBR
		allow_overlord_canton = yes
		priority = 950
		trigger = { coa_def_british_ensign_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# vanilla
		coa = BRZ_subject_USA
		allow_overlord_canton = yes
		overlord_canton_scale = { 0.5 0.54 }
		priority = 950
		trigger = { coa_def_american_ensign_trigger = yes }

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:FOZ = {	# French zone of Germany: C pennant
	flag_definition = {
		coa = cwp_GER_occupied_1946
		subject_canton = cwp_GER_occupied_1946
		priority = 900
	}
	flag_definition = {	# Federal German flag
		coa = GER_modern
		subject_canton = GER_modern
		priority = 990
		trigger = { coa_def_independent_trigger = yes }
	}
	flag_definition = {	# vanilla GER
		coa = GER_ddr
		subject_canton = GER_ddr
		priority = 1500
		trigger = {
			scope:actor ?= {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state
						py:communist_party ?= {
							any_member = { is_in_government = yes }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						OR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_technocracy
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_oligarchy
						}
						ruler ?= {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						is_subject = yes
						overlord = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_presidential_republic
				}
			}
		}
	}
	flag_definition = {	# vanilla GER
		coa = GER_fascist
		subject_canton = GER_fascist
		priority = 1250
		trigger = { coa_def_fascist_flag_trigger = yes }
